- [ ] Low (UI glitch, minor annoyance)

- [ ] Doctor Dashboard / Consultation
- [ ] Nurse Triage / Registration

1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'

If applicable, add screenshots or error log traces to help explain your problem.
